info.title: StuHelper Media API
info.description: Authenticated logical files and immutable versions. Server-owned purpose profiles select quarantine and publication protection. Upload, approval, business reference publication and storage readiness are separate gates. No provider locator or credential is exposed.

cleanup_complete.description: This version has released its storage handle. Shared bytes remain while other handles use them. If this is the final handle, true requires physical cleanup to finish.

reused.description: True when this independent version uses a verified prior upload without sending client file bytes. It still requires its own business approval. While verifying, query the upload status and do not send file bytes.

reuse_existing.description: Attempt to reuse a completed upload owned by the current user with the same purpose, configured protection, content type, size and SHA-256. A different user digest alone never skips upload. Omission disables reuse.
